description: Search the web: returns titles, URLs and snippets (5 by default). Read pages with web_extract. The query is passed through to the configured backend, so operators such as site:domain, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, and "exact phrase" may work when the backend supports them.
name: web_search

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The search query to look up on the web. You may include backend-supported operators such as site:example.com, filetype:pdf, intitle:word, -term, or "exact phrase".

stakes.description: Optional. Classify the WHOLE TASK CONTEXT, not only the search words. Omit stakes or pass high for legal, financial, tax, medical/health, compliance, official-source work (including authoritative vendor docs/API facts and contact verification), current events/news, prices, safety, time-critical work (including support escalation/production outages), non-English or uncertain cases, and anything costly to get wrong. Use standard only for nonprotected commodity tutorials, how-tos, recipes, navigation or background where error is genuinely cheap. standard may use a cheaper search tier, subject to a query-only protected guard that cannot see surrounding task context. When unsure, omit.
